{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Channel values:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Customer segment values:", df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Status values:", df['status'].unique())
print("Converted values:", df['converted'].unique())
print("Revenue sample:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())
print("Customer age sample:", df['customer_age'].head(5).tolist())
print("Customer age -1 count:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders count:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA orders sample:", qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status']].head().values)

# Check if any rows have both revenue='999999.99' and converted=1
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]
print("QA orders with converted=1:", len(qa_converted))"}
